description.value: The Firehall Arts Centre is one of Vancouver's oldest arts venues, housed in a converted heritage firehall in the Downtown Eastside and presenting theatre, dance, music, comedy, and community events. It is a producing and presenting house with capacity for 175, championing local and Indigenous storytelling on unceded Musqueam, Squamish, and Tsleil-Waututh territory. A touring cyclist exploring Vancouver's DTES cultural corridor would find a lively, year-round performance calendar here.

The venue is clearly active with a 2025–26 season announced, so confirmed_open is true.
